tasks.short: Arrange interlibrary loans for unavailable materials

steps.what: Verify the requested material, local unavailability and eligible lending libraries
Prepare, verify and send the interlibrary loan request
Track the request and coordinate receipt or unresolved lending conditions

tasks.design: Configure request reuse and status alerts in {OTHER}, the interlibrary-loan system. The librarian checks the exact request before sending and handles lender conditions and exceptions manually.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified bibliographic and patron details may be entered again in lending requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Native request forms and status views can reuse checked records.
tasks.still_hard: Lenders may impose conditions or lack the requested edition.
tasks.human_edge: The librarian negotiates alternatives and protects patron information.
tasks.altitude: Less request entry and status checking; lending commitments remain human decisions.

evidence.claim: Native library request forms and alerts can reduce repeated entry and status lookup; savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers request arrangement and status coordination, excluding lender work and physical transport.

Librarian produces edition identifier, patron reference, selected lender, needed date and local availability result in s1's40 hours. Lender responses remain human-readable unless an existing structured status is supplied by the lender's normal transaction process. Missing fields or unmatched statuses are handled manually in retained s2 and s3 time.
Test existing interlibrary-loan configuration first; existing transaction runtime is not saved labour.
research_questions: Does reuse reduce total request work after edition checks and exception handling?

already_counted.description: Exact request check and lending exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain lender forms and status mappings

approvals.approved_version: Final request snapshot with edition, lender, patron reference, date and accepted conditions; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70, gross30 minus4 upkeep net26. Low assumes only10 hours removed due to unsupported lenders; all40 verification hours remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach patrons basic computer and database skills

steps.what: Identify the patron's computer skills and intended database search
Teach and practise basic computer skills with the patron
Observe independent practice and clarify remaining difficulties

tasks.design: Keep individual instruction and observed practice human, using {OTHER}, the existing computer and database interface. No separate lesson drafting or repeated administration is assumed in this short patron-support task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The patron may need physical demonstration and reassurance.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technology is required for the retained service.
tasks.still_hard: Different accessibility needs and unfamiliarity with interfaces.
tasks.human_edge: The librarian notices confusion and adapts the pace.
tasks.altitude: No change in contact time or teaching responsibility.

evidence.claim: Individual guided practice and observation remain human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is an individual computer-skills interaction, excluding separate class planning and source research tasks.
Librarian identifies goals and observed difficulties in s1's20 hours; no structured learner profile is assumed or created for free.
Existing interfaces are the baseline. No new tool or upkeep is added, justifying zero incremental work.
research_questions: Which difficulties require live demonstration rather than existing help material?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and zero upkeep; all individual teaching and practice support remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check books in and out of the library

steps.what: Identify books and the borrower or return transaction and verify exceptions
Enter the book check-in or check-out transaction in the circulation record
Handle book handover and explain due dates or unresolved exceptions

tasks.design: Configure scan-to-post in {OTHER}, the library circulation system, where staff currently re-enter verified transactions. Retain identification, exception handling and physical book handover; already automatic postings receive no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some desks repeat entry after identifying the book and borrower.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing circulation systems can post transactions from checked scans.
tasks.still_hard: Missing labels, borrower restrictions and disputed returns.
tasks.human_edge: The librarian resolves exceptions without misidentifying patrons or materials.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry only; patron service and handling time stay intact.

evidence.claim: Native scan-to-post circulation is plausible deterministic configuration; savings apply only to desks with duplicate entry.

assumptions: Boundary covers staff check-in/out and handover, excluding shelving and patron self-service labour.

Librarian produces verified item ID, borrower ID for loans, transaction type and exception clearance in s1's40 hours. The system supplies transaction timestamp and rule-derived due date. Missing labels or unclear identity require manual entry and verification, counted in exceptions.
Test native scanning first. If posting is already automatic, s2 is system runtime and the rollout has no labour-saving case.
unknowns: Whether transaction entry is already automatic
Share of unreadable labels and circulation exceptions
research_questions: Is there actual repeated staff entry after book and borrower verification?

incremental.description: Maintain scan configuration and investigate posting failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional E1 B100 R80, gross20 minus3 upkeep net17 for a desk with manual repeat entry. Low assumes only3 hours avoidable entry; already automatic desks should not deploy a new change.

tasks.short: Maintain circulation and inventory records and correct cataloging errors

steps.what: Inspect inventory and capture discrepancies against material and circulation records
Compare captured inventory observations with existing records and locate mismatches
Investigate mismatches and correct confirmed cataloging or inventory errors

tasks.design: Use native inventory reconciliation in {OTHER}, the library management system, before custom comparison code. Match exact item identifiers and status fields, while the librarian investigates mismatches and decides all corrections.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff may repeatedly compare observations with separate circulation and inventory views.
tasks.enabler_now: A configured comparison can surface exact identifier and status mismatches.
tasks.still_hard: A missing item is not automatically lost and a valid heading may still be wrong.
tasks.human_edge: The librarian resolves physical discrepancies and semantic catalogue errors.
tasks.altitude: Less mechanical comparison; correction authority remains human.

reach.learn: Stable item identifiers and discrepancy investigation

evidence.claim: Exact identifier and status comparisons can support library inventory reconciliation without deciding semantic corrections.

assumptions: Boundary covers periodic record maintenance and inventory discrepancies. Live check-in/out posting belongs to task22407 and is not saved again here.

Librarian captures item ID, observed location, observed availability and observation date in s1's40 hours. Existing circulation transactions produce recorded status in their own task. No free discrepancy code is assumed: s2 compares observations; missing IDs or conflicting records go to manual investigation in s3.
Test native inventory reports first. New records are never silently corrected from a mismatch alone.
unknowns: Inventory frequency and current comparison process
research_questions: Can comparison reduce staff effort without creating false missing-item findings?

incremental.description: Maintain match rules and investigate recurring comparison failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80, gross20 minus4 upkeep net16. Low assumes only5 hours mechanical comparison removed; physical capture40 and correction20 remain unchanged.

reach: Coach library technicians on inventory and circulation exceptions
